goal: Strengthen the existing API Deprecation Archive into a deterministic migration-history registry without discarding its v0.1 entity/event/evidence model or existing public lifecycle surfaces.

stage2_prerequisite.problem: The public display seed is ahead of the schema-validated canonical entity/event/evidence layer. Deterministic AI-era surfaces must not promote the lightweight display manifest into canonical authority.
stage2_prerequisite.rule: Complete or explicitly resolve the missing canonical backfill before machine JSON, Compare or Stats can be treated as canonical registry outputs.

legacy_pr_handling.head: canonical-json-backfill-pr-019
legacy_pr_handling.rule: Do not merge the two aggregate canonical staging bundles wholesale. Reuse only reviewed facts/IDs that can be mapped into the current schema-validated per-file entity/event/evidence model and source policy.

implementation_rule: Audit current main first; preserve existing public API/deadline/deprecated/removed/replacement/provider/timeline surfaces; fix the canonical 20-vs-5 split before building deterministic machine outputs; implement only verified gaps; require validation green and production verification for public runtime changes.
